title: Health Charted Decisions
description: Permanent decision log. Never pruned. Reversals reference originals.

decision_id.description: Stable identifier for cross-referencing this decision from other entries

context.description: Situation and motivating factors at the time of the decision

owner.description: Who made the decision (user, framework, joint) and any analytical roles

outcome.description: What is expected if this option were chosen

evidence_referenced.description: Research, reference, or my-data files cited as evidence for this decision.

secondary_effects_surfaced.description: Downstream effects identified during decision-making (interactions, monitoring needs, schedule shifts) that should be tracked separately.

review_at.description: Trigger or date for revisiting this decision (e.g., 'after 6mo DFI re-test', '2026-12-01')

outcome.description: Filled later when outcome is known

reversed_by.description: Date and reference to the reversal decision, if reversed

lifecycle_status.description: Current lifecycle state of this decision. proposed = drafted, awaiting commitment; accepted = committed but not yet executed; executed = action taken; superseded = replaced by later decision (use reversed_by to reference).

lifecycle_status_since.description: ISO date the current lifecycle_status began

lifecycle_status_notes.description: Free-text rationale or context for the current status
